blurb: Guests rent rowboats to paddle on Clove Lake, enjoying a peaceful natural setting shaped by glaciers. Options include self-rowing rentals and guided scenic boat rides. Private events and school programs are available with customized packages.
extraNote: $10 refundable deposit required (cash or card) · No refunds · 2-3 day notice required for private events · Appointment for private events should be on weekdays unless otherwise arranged · Public Parking lot at Park Dr
